tokens.name: bg-ground
tokens.usage: App background and the base of every screen. Also the inset well behind the preset selector and path field.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: File rows and the settings panel.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, progress-bar track, hover on rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and row outlines. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Dashed outline of the drop zone.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and buttons that must be seen as controls (3:1 on bg-ground and bg-surface).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on any background token.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, original sizes, hints, queued rows. 5:1 or better on bg-ground, bg-surface and bg-raised.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Signal blue. Start button, selected preset, savings figures, progress fill, focus ring. Nothing decorative.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the WebP nudge strip inside a file row.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Skipped label. Amber, not red: a skip is an honest outcome, not an error.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark: “smart” at 400 in text-muted, “press” at 700 in text.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text, file names, option labels.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Every pixel kept. Saves far less.
styles.usage: Hints and secondary lines under an option or row.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels and column headers, always uppercase.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: File sizes, savings, progress, the status bar.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside the preset selector.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and between file rows (6–8).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row grid gap, row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between main-column blocks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Window side padding, header and footer insets.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Format badges (JPG, PNG, PDF).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons (Convert, Show in folder), version tag.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nudge strip.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: File rows, preset selector, Start button.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Drop zone, app window.
